batting.name: P Nissanka
batting.dismissal: c P Simran Singh b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c SS Iyer b XC Bartlett

batting.name: Priyansh Arya
batting.dismissal: c Sameer Rizvi b AR Patel

batting.name: N Wadhera
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b V Nigam

balls.text: gets a low full toss just outside off, and swipes it to fine leg. Good ball from Arsh to finish
that's Rahul's 150!! He's only the third batter to get there in IPL. Slower ball from Arsh, who bowls short. Rahul waits for the ball to shape into him, and upper cuts late to go over the keeper
another yorker. This is great execution. Arsh bowls this on off, and Miller squeezes it out to long-on
short in length again, and just outside off. Swat-pulled to deep midwicket
good bowling. Arsh bowls a low full toss on middle and off, with a hint of the ball swinging in. Clipped to deep midwicket
bowls a short delivery outside off, and Rahul swats it to long-on
on the bounce to deep cover point. Short in length, and wide of off, as Rahul slashes hard at it
sweeps this from wide of off to deep square leg. Bartlett bowls one fullish and wide of off, but Rahul goes low and reaches out at this slower ball to go over the man at square leg
very wide of off. Bartlett bowls from wide of the crease, and lands it full on a 15th-stump line. Left alone by Rahul
slower ball from Bartlett again, and short in length as well. This moves away after pitching on middle, and Miller pulls it from wide of off to deep square leg

got him!! Rana misses out on a hundred. Iyer, at mid-off, does well to move and reach out to his right. He takes it high, and ends a massive stand. Bartlett angled one in, and bowled a low full toss outside leg. Rana backed away and looked to loft, but couldn't break through the in field
he waits, waits more... and pulls this slower ball over the keeper. From back of the hand, and short of a length around leg. The ball shapes away, and Rana is alert to the chance
six to welcome him back!! Rana makes room, Bartlett follows, but it's still six. Short in length, and wide of leg. Rana swat-pulls over deep-backward square leg

swat-pulled to deep square leg. He gets on top of this bouncer, which is actually an offcutter pitching on off. Rahul rolls his wrists, and crashes the ball in the gap on the longer side of the ground
bottom edge to short fine leg. A rare sequence of only two runs in four successive balls. He goes swinging at this full ball, but plays too early
Rana is beaten. Jansen stays around the stumps, and bowls full and just outside off. Rana looks to swing, but misses

extra bounce, and Rahul is hit on helmet as he looks to pull. Jansen went for the short ball this time, and it shaped back in to finish on leg. Rahul was beaten, as the ball hit his right arm and the side of the helmet. It's given as runs, though, and not leg bye. So the ball must have flicked his gloves. The concussion test is a mere formality
Rahul backs away, but finds the man at extra cover. On a length on the stumps, and he made room to attack this one
this stand is now worth 204!! Jansen angled in a slower delivery, but on a friendly, hittable length on off. Rahul cleared his front leg, and went over long-on

gone!! Good catch by Stoinis. PBKS break a humungous stand. Rana goes slogging at this full toss, as the ball dipped on to him outside leg. But for the second time in the over, Rana can't clear the boundary off a full toss. Stoinis, at deep-backward square leg, does well to move and tumble to his right to complete the catch... but wait, the third umpire will confirm about it. He's not satisfied with the first angle, though. As Stoinis dives, his right leg seems to be touching the boundary cushion while he completes the catch, which is what is prompting the third umpire to check multiple replays. Here comes a third angle for the third umpire. Stoinis, though, seems in control of the ball all through. So that aspect is clear, I'd think. Ohh, a zoomed-in frame shows his right boot may have just tickled the cushion. Hang on, hang on!! The third umpire feels a certain portion of the toblerone has been touched while Stoinis dived. So Rana gets a life. Delhi is roaring. Shreyas and Ponting are wondering
still no boundary in this over so far. Short of a length and wide of off, and turning away to finish wider. Rahul swats it to deep extra cover
he skips down the pitch, converts this into a high-ish full toss on leg, but mistimes the hoick to deep midwicket. Just a single in the end
good stuff from Chahal. He fires a yorker in line with the stumps, and all Rahul can do is jam it to long-on
another wide. Chahal bowls fullish and wide of off, and Rahul lets it go
a yorker on middle and leg, and clipped wide of long-on
floated wide of off, and left alone. Angled across, and full in length. Wide called
direct hit, but Rahul was in!! Rahul went for the reverse sweep, but got a bottom edge off this ball angled into middle and leg. The ball trickled to Chahal's left, and he threw it back at his end
four in a row. This full toss is on middle, and whipped to deep midwicket
full toss again... but it's a four this time. Vyshak bowls this lowish, and on off. Rahul receives it gleefully, and goes over the bowler's head
full toss again, and six again. Vyshak giving everything away. Slower ball, but this one dips on to him on off, and Rahul capitalises on another full toss to bash it over long-off
But the change of angle doesn't matter. Vyshak angles this across, and ends up bowling a knee-height full toss outside off. Rahul goes low, and swipes to go over fine leg
another bouncer, and wide called. Vyshak pitches this on off, and Rahul sways out of the way. The ball drops in the front of the keeper
Rahul hits back with a six!! He heaves across the line to go over midwicket. Vyshak bowls a legcutter on a full length in and around off, and Rahul is ready
little pace, but extra bounce. Good delivery in the end. A bouncer just outside off, and Rahul shapes to swat but lets it go, seeing the ball shape away after pitching
Another big over for DC. It's a single to end, though. Full delivery on middle and off, and punched to deep extra cover

wow, how did that reach the boundary?! That helps Rahul reach his hundred off 47 balls. Jansen keeps going with a lack of pace, and on a full length just outside off. This time Rahul pumps him back to beat long-off to his right. Great timing and placement

chipped to deep-backward point, and Rahul pushes for two. Jansen again bowls full and slow, and just outside off. Rahul's bottom hand came off the bat as he looked to loft at it, but was safe in the end
hacked away to deep point. A late cut using his bottom hand. This is a full ball landing around fifth stump, and a slower one too. Rahul lets the ball move across, before attacking it
yorker on off, and he gets an inside edge to dribble towards cover as he looks to drive at it
DC are chugging along, giving PBKS  taste of their own medicine. Slower ball - a knuckle delivery - which is full and just outside off, and Rana lofts it back over the bowler's head

amazing shot. There isn't much scope to play the slice there, given how full the ball is. In fact, it's nearly a yorker, before Rahul drags it as a low full toss from just outside off. Beats Jansen to his right at deep third
angled across, and Rana gets across the stumps as well. It is a low full toss wide of off, and Rana swings to deep midwicket
finally a respite for Arsh. This is a low full toss, but wide of off. Swiped to long-on
slower ball, but four. Nothing is working for PBKS. Arsh bowls on the shorter side of a length, and on off. Rahul lets the ball seam away a bit, and swats it back down the ground
bam!! The ball lands deep down the ground. Arsh bowls a full delivery angling across, but the line is slightly wide of off. That's enough for Rahul to have a liberal swing of the arms
top edge, and over the keeper. But hey, Rahul wasn't playing the pull; instead, it was an attempted reverse scoop. Arsh went fullish and straight, and Rahul turned around to attack early
good ball. On a yorker length just outside off, and dragged to deep cover
not given wide... and DC don't review. Stoinis keeps bowling full and wide of off, and Rahu lets this go as well
finally the lack of pace works for Stoinis. He persists with the offcutter, and goes full around seventh stump. Rahul has a swing across the line, but is beaten
another wide. Stoinis is feeling pressure. He goes very full and wide outside off, and Rahul leaves it alone
flayed away over cover point. Rahul joins the six party. There was enough room available for Rahul to launch the ball with a fairly horizontal bat, as it was full and wide of off
short and slow again from Stoinis. He nearly cramps Rana for room by landing this on leg, but Rana swats it away to deep midwicket by playing it from just outside leg stump
lack of pace again from Stoinis. But this ball is short and a little wide of off. Rahul picks it up and pulls hard to deep midwicket
starts with a wide. Stoinis floats a slower ball on a full length wide of off, and Rahul lets it go

that's 28 runs off the over!! Rana starts and ends the over with a six. Bartlett went on a fullish length, angling it away and again bowling around sixth stump. Rana hung deep in the crease, and thumped it over cover again
through extra cover. Bartlett looks blown away. He angles one across, and ends up bowling a low full toss slightly wide of off. Rana reaches out, and creams it for four more

some luck also favours Rana. Bartlett shifts his length to a short one, but a top edge from Rana takes the ball over the man at short third. He went for the pull from just outside off, but seemed to have played early
fifty for Rana!! It's now 6, 4, 4. Chahal is beaten again. Rana scoops again, as he gets another full delivery on leg

Fumble from Chahal at short fine leg, and it's four. Good awareness from Rana, though. He shaped to scoop, but waited as Bartlett bowled a slower ball. It was full and on leg, and Rana scooped it late to place it on the bounce to Chahal's left
just beats the man at deep midwicket!! Rana targets the shorter boundary, as he goes pulling at this short delivery arriving just outside off. Timed well enough in the end for six
another dot. Chahal persists with the line wide-ish of off. Full again, and around sixth stump. Rahul lets it go, and the ball turns away
nicely bowled!! Much slower from Chahal, at 78.5kph. He tosses it up, lands it full around sixth stump, and has Rahul driving away from himself. Rahul is beaten, though
ohh, beats Chahal, the umpire and the stumps at the other end. Again Rahul advances, and though this ball is flatter and fullish around off, Rahul bashes it back to go down the ground
down the pitch... and beats Jansen at long-off. Rahul converts this into a full ball dipping on middle and leg, and lofts with the line to get it past Jansen, who was running to his right
good ball. Chahal angles it across, and fires a low full toss just outside off. Driven back to Chahal's right, as the ball deflects off his hands
Chahal goes very full and slow, and on the stumps. Rahul nudges it to long-on too... and there's a belated blare of the no-ball siren. Chahal's front foot just landed outside the crease
full and tossed up. It dips on leg, and Rana drags it to long-on
Drives through the line and holds the pose! Pitched up and pace off, Rahul drives over the bowler
Almost the same. 121ks and rises around rib-height, cut to extra cover
Slow and into the pitch outside off, cut with limited timing to cover. 119ks
Pulls the short ball to deep midwicket

Life No. 2 for KL Rahul. Slower length ball just outside off at 117ks. Rahul crouched a bit and cuffed it. Wanted to slap it through cover but bat turned inwards and Rahul lost the grip. Vyshak stopped and got a touch low to try and take the catch, ball deflected off his hands towards cover
Rahul brings up his 43rd IPL fifty by flicking a length ball from the top of the stumps to the edge of the ring at midwicket.
92ks flat length ball on leg. Rahul makes room and looks to whack it with a vertical bat through mid-on, gets an inside edge to deep square leg
Dances down and gets to the pitch of the loopy length ball on leg, flicked to short fine leg
Pitched up at the stumps, swept to deep midwicket
Full on leg, swept to deep-backward square. 89ks
Touch wide and fullish, driven along the ground through cover
Goes back and flicks the length ball from leg stump, to long-on
Low full toss on leg at pace. 132ks. Flicked uppishly to deep midwicket
Pitched up on off, 135ks, punched to long-on
Pulls the short ball from shoulder height to deep midwicket. 107ks. Looked slow off the pitch too
Short on leg, 123ks, pulled to deep forward square

Shedge fumbles at backward point with Ponting chatting on air. He pauses and continues speaking. Was a length ball outside off that was cut low to his right, ball hit low on the fingers and brushed through
Slow length ball on leg, flicked to midwicket
Prabhsimran comes to life with a shriek, tells midwicket to throw it to him which is what happens. 91ks full ball was flicked towards the infielder. TImeout
Goes back and flicks it off top of leg to long-on
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg
Goes back and opens his stance to work it to long-on
Rahul takes on Chahal like he did Hazlewood vs RCB. He has a good record against him. Gets a fullish legbreak on off, takes a step and drives through the line over long-on
Full and slow on off, 88ks, flicked to long-on
Rahul makes too much room. Went for the cut but the distance between body and ball and the lack of pace took the ball into the pitch and back to the bowler

Miscued pull but into the outfield and in the gap. Deep square leg out and this goes over midwicket. Was a lower bouncer over leg stump, Rahul moved leg side within the crease and pulled it from shoulder-height. Off the upper half of the bat
Low full toss on off, 118ks, flicked towards midwicket. Rana had to delay his shot, imparted no power
Fullish length ball on leg, flicked towards square leg
Back to the slow stuff. Length ball lands on off and jumps around waist-height while angling away to fourth stump. Rahul goes for a wristy cover drive as he couldn't extend his arms. Misses
138ks full ball on leg, flicked to midwicket's left. Mid-on scampers and throws at the non-striker's, hits Rana's foot but not the stumps
Vyshank lucky it's not a beamer. Full toss slips out just under the hips, at leg stump too, perfect direction for a help-away flick. Ball goes very fine
Pitched up outside off, 134ks, driven to deep point. Feel like Rana can go aerial to some of these
Shashank misfields. Can't catch a break. Moved to the right, ball went lower than his fingers and beat him. Was a full ball outside off that was driven through cover
Rana doesn't miss out on this full ball. Wobble seam, just outside off, Rana wristily drives it through the squarer side of cover. Aong the ground
Pitched up just outside off, driven to cover
Yorker attempted, shin-high full toss just outside off. Punched to long-on
Another slower one. Fullish outside off, tapped to short third, who is slightly square and runs in quickly
Pitched right up on off, 139ks, driven to mid-off.
Length outside off, driven off the back foot to deep point's left. 116ks, that slowed off the pitch considerably
Arya fumbles at deep third, ran right and slid. Got his hands too low, the ball ping-ponged off his wrists to the boundary. Was a shortish ball outside off that was cut into the outfield
Jansen misses his yorker and Rana glances it away. To the right of short fine leg. Seam-up on leg stump, just over the shoe. Not too pacy, Rana gets back in the crease and grounds the shot
Slow and fullish on leg, flicked to midwicket

Deep-backward square out but doesn't stop Rahul from pulling, he gets it just in front of square too. 128ks short ball around neck height just outside off, Rahul kept his eye on the ball for a long time before swivelling and swingling his arms
Yorker on leg stump, flicked to deep fine leg

Rahul dropped, Nissanka not. Outswinger on a slight back of length, pace on. Finished around off stump, Nissanka looked to pull it again. He did that to similar balls to get a couple of boundaries earlier but this time, the bat face opened up and the ball went right up. Prabhsimran runs in a couple of steps and takes it
Fuller side of length on leg, clipped leg side

Shashank's fielding nightmare bleeds across games. He stood on the deep-square-leg boundary, lunged back on his right leg and looked to take a reverse-cupped catch around his left shoulder. Ball spilled through his fingers as his head tilts left. Was a length ball at the hips, Rahul looks to replicate Nissanka's pick-up pull. Arshdeep was celebrating and had to stop
Length on off at 132ks, worked back to the bowler
Nissanka helps one away again. His lack of height helps here. Gets upright, stays slightly open and pulls the 134ks pull across the top of his thighs. Four through backward square leg.
Length on off, Rahul defended it off the back foot to the leg side of the pitch. Bowler runs around it, ball goes towards mid-on and they pinch one
Bit of swing away on the full ball at off, full-faced punch takes it to mid-on, who's halfway back
Waits for the length ball to come around off and punches towards cover for a quick single

Flick with a windscreen wipe. Rahul's follow-through goes well beyond his shoulder after he flicks the fullish outswinger going away outside off over mid-on. His weight was mostly on the front leg and the bat path was from slip through mid-on
Width offered, Rahul takes a small stride forward and uses his hands to reach out and drive it through point
Length outside off, drives it towards backward point
Length on top of off, no room but Nissanka square drives it anyway. Open face, went off the sticker to deep point
Arshdeep misses his line, Nissanka helps it away. Pace-on length ball on leg, outswinger attempted but no movement. Nissanka gets on one leg and puls it fine
In-swinging yorker on fourth stump at 135ks, Rahul waits and jams it with an open-face. Ball trickles off the toe off side, along the crease
Low in-swinging full toss on leg, flicked to deep-backward square
Bit of in swing to beat the cut. Fuller side of length just outside off, Nissanka looked to go square, the seam was pointing to first slip, so it might have been seam movement

it's a wide, and PBKS win!! Nattu bowls this short on off, and the ball shapes away to finish wide of off. Iyer lets it go. With that, PBKS now hold the record of the highest successful chase across all T20s
another low full toss just outside off. Driven to long-off
bang!! The ball lands 15 rows deep behind the midwicket boundary. He gets a full toss just outside off, and thrashes at it to go across the line
good delivery. Nattu goes for a low full toss on off, and it's clipped to deep midwicket
this is a yorker around sixth stump. Shashank has a drive at it but misses
four between the keeper and short fine leg. Shashank gets across and goes low, before scooping this low full toss wide of off
this time Mukesh executes the yorker. It's just outside off, and all Iyer can do is jam his bat down for the ball to go to extra cover
Mukesh attempts the yorker, but just falls short. The line is just outside off, and Shashank wallops it from there to deep square leg
the sound off the bat was delicious. Shashank is deep in his crease, and picks this short ball from around seventh stump to pull it hard and wide of long-on
nicely bowled. Mukesh lands a yorker bang on off stump, and Iyer squeezes it to point
on the fuller side, and a little wide of off. Shashank has a push at it from deep in the crease, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to fine leg
aerially flicks this full ball swinging into him, and places it in the gap at deep square leg. Iyer wanted two, but Shashank denied, leaving his captain unhappy
barely beats a jumping Mukesh at short third!! Shashank went hoicking at this full ball arriving around sixth stump, but got it off the outside edge. Mukesh leaped and nearly got  a finger
good comeback. Nattu bowls a yorker on off, and Iyer drives it to long-on
swatted over extra cover. PBKS are running away with this. Short ball on middle and off, and a slower one. The ball shaped away, and Iyer thumped it late
more fun for Iyer. He gets a full toss above his knee around off, and crashes it over deep square leg

another attempted yorker, but this lands outside leg. Wide not called, but Iyer reviews. Iyer is deep in the crease, and moves across the stumps a little. Nattu, meanwhile, fires it just outside leg. The third umpire says the ball would have met Iyer had he retained his position and not moved to the off side
lovely ball. He swings it in, and bowls a near yorker on the stumps. Shashank shifts his weight back to flick it to deep square leg
this is a dot, but it's still 23 runs off the over. Quicker and flatter on a length wide of off. Iyer went hacking but was beaten
flatter and harder this time. It's is Iyer's fifty too, which comes in 26 balls. This ball was tossed up, and it dipped on off, as Iyer got down to slog sweep it wide of long-on
short again, and six again. Kuldeep pitched this on middle and leg, and Iyer let the ball turn away slightly, before pulling hard to go over midwicket

wide down the leg side. The ball is full as Iyer looks to sweep but misses. Wide called... but DC review. There's a considerable wait before the third umpire is heard. Kuldeep bowled this full and around sixth stump outside leg. Iyer went sweeping but missed. There's a hint of movement of his back leg, which seems to be taking a step towards the off stump. There's no bat involved, and neither has the ball tickled the pad. Finally, it's confirmed to be a wide
very full on the stumps, and drilled back down the ground
Nair drops Iyer again!! A length ball from Kuldeep, as Iyer went pulling but skied it to long-on. It was the wrong 'un from Kuldeep, and Iyer survived again. Surprisingly, the batters didn't run
Chameera gets a hand, but it's still six. Full delivery on leg, and Iyer rammed a pull to fine leg

Nair drops a sitter!! He was at long-off, from where he took a few steps forward and settled under the ball. But it popped out as he looked to catch. This time it was Iyer who looked to loft Nigam down the ground, but ended up ballooning it for a chance which was eventually missed

there are cries of "catch, catch, catch" from Stubbs... but the ball lands between the extra cover turning and running forward, and the deep-cover fielder moving across to his right. Shashank sliced this full ball aerially, and nearly gave his wicket away
loopy and a yorker around sixth stump. Jammed back by Shashank

Nair, a sub fielder, tip-toes on the long-on boundary, and takes the catch. He eventually ended a good step inside the field of play. Nigam tossed one up at Wadhera, who saw the ball dipping on a stump-to-stump, and went heaving. The boundary at long-on isn't the biggest, but Wadhera's placement wasn't the best either
this time Wadhera beats Miller. He backs away, and drills this very full ball on off wide of long-off

Chameera turned into Superman for a second, but couldn't get a hand on the ball. Wadhera reverse swept this full ball, and sent it flying to deep cover point, even as Chameera ran and threw himself to his right
ends the over with a slower short ball. Nattu lands it on the stumps, and it shapes away to finish outside off. Iyer went to ramp but missed
a knee-height full toss slightly wide of off. Driven hard to deep cover point
this takes off from the top half of the bat, and flies over the man at short fine leg. Nattu bowled this on a short of a length, and the ball seamed in, before Wadhera had a swing at it
this ball keeps a little off a short of a length on leg. Iyer goes back to whip it to deep square leg
short in length on off, and he mistimes a pull to deep midwicket

a slower-ball bouncer. It isn't called wide, so the batters have a word and review. Nattu banged the ball around eighth stump, and the first replay indicates it being at almost par with Wadhera's head. It's not a wide as per the line, the third umpire says. Now he wants to confirm for height. We keep waiting... After a minute or so, the side-on angle comes up and reveals the ball is above Wadhera's head height. Now comes UltraEdge, and it's confirmed that there's no bat involved. Ultimately, though, it's a wide for height
just beats a leaping Chameera at point!! It was a low full toss around sixth stump, and Wadhera sliced it aerially for four to deep-backward point
another one. Nearly a carbon copy of the last ball. Wide called again. This full ball swings in and lands wider of leg, as Wadhera went to clip but missed
darts one wide of leg. The ball is angling into Wadhera, who looks to flick but misses as the ball lands outside leg
a quiet over for PBKS. Iyer drives this full delivery slightly wide of off to the man at extra cover
he backs away, and Axar bowls on a short of a length. Iyer ends up swatting back to Axar
another full delivery, but this is around middle and leg. Punched to long-on to keep ticking
this is full, straight, and slower. Iyer goes back to clip to deep square leg
he sweeps this full ball from off, and to short fine leg. But they pinch a run hurriedly
fullish ball on off, and driven to deep cover point
nearly beats Wadhera, who manages to get some bat on it. Kuldeep goes full and just outside off, and Wadhera drives to cover
again Kuldeep bowls on a fullish length on Iyer's pads. This is nudged to deep midwicket
good running. It's a full ball just outside leg, and he goes back to nudge towards deep square leg
punches this back-of-a-length ball to long-off
Wadhera shapes to reverse sweep... and Kuldeep bowls wide of off. The ball turns away further, and Wadhera lets it go
on the bounce to the man at deep midwicket. Kuldeep goes slower this time, and on a length around off. Iyer swings across the line
another six!! Kuldeep bowls short, and pays. This ball arrives around middle and leg, and Iyer clears his front leg to go over square leg
extra bounce off a full length for Nigam. The ball lands on off and rises nicely, as Iyer has to dab it to short third after shaping to sweep
here it comes!! The ball ballooned up a few miles, before it landed past the sightscreen. Slower and fuller from Nigam, as Iyer picked it up from off
on a fullish length, and quicker, on off. It turns away, and Iyer punches to cover
outside leg again, and wide. Quicker, and on a length, as Iyer looked to bosh at it but missed
fuller and slower, and dipping on middle. Pushed back aerially to Nigam's left
on a length on the stumps, and turning away. Punched to midwicket
down the leg, and four. Nigam bowled on a short of a length, and on leg. Iyer moved back to sweep off the bottom of the bat, and beat short fine leg to his right
Juicy full ball wide of off. Spins away and beats the lofted cover drive
Length on leg, looks to punch it towards midwicket. Goes off the outer-half to the bowler's right
Fullish on leg, flicked to midwicket
Pitched up on off, worked to long-on

Googly to wave Connolly goodbye!. 89ks length ball lands just outside off and rips back in, Connolly took a stride across and went for the flowing cover drive. Missed it completely and ball knocked top of middle
Full outside off, driven through cover. Hits the gap nicely
89ks fullish length ball o off, punched to the bowler
Flicks it off a length to deep midwicket
Length just outside off, worked to long-on
Length on leg, clipped to long-on
Punches the full ball to long-on

Mukesh tumbles and rolls in front of the boundary.... Axar signals six. Mukesh is confident though. Boundary catch sent upstairs. Mukesh moved to the left from long leg, took it over the right shoulder, he stepped aside and the back heel slid back. The knee followed. Third umpire says the 'cushion clearly moved'. Was a length ball down leg that was slog swept flat
Length around off, punched firmly to long-on
Pitched up at the stumps, punched back to the bowler
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket

Low bounce and that looked out. Did it pitch in line? Seemed like it. Prabh and Connolly chat, review taken. 86ks shortish ball at middle. Prabhsimran's back leg was just outside off and front leg just outside leg as the ball went under the pull shot and hit him just over the front pad. The short ball landed in line with middle stump and would go on to hit top of middle and leg. Three reds, Prabhsimran grimaces as high-fives take over
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket

Catch is the call but it goes in the gap at cover. Overpitched on off with flight, Connolly was leg side of the ball, still for the most part and then waiting for the ball to pass his front leg before driving
Length on middle from around, 90ks, driven to long-off

Straight to deep midwicket! Very much defensive bowling from Axar. 92ks length ball on middle and leg with three deep fielders stationed leg side. Priyansh pulled it from the crease, got it off the bottom and it was a bread-basket catch for Rizvi
Length on off, driven to deep cover
Reverse sweeps it two bounces over the point boundary. Prabh changing his stance but not his grip, got on one knee like a left-hander and launched it from the stumps, off a length
Full on leg, flicked to midwicket
Brave ball. Loopy on a length down leg, glanced off the back foot with the spin. Too fine for short 45

Dropped and that's six fours in a row! The timeout taken right away by DC! Prabhsimran pulled that so hard that his bottom hand slipped off the handle. It went up, Stubbs ran in and slid but the ball yorked him and bounced past him. 116-run powerplay, Second-highest in IPL history only behind SRH's 125
4, 4, 4, 4, 4! Thick outside edge this time. Cross-seam yorker aimed wide of off. Misses by a distance, the high full toss goes off the edge between keeper and short third

Wowza! That's a reverse skewer over short third from the edge of the pitch! Prabhsimran got across in the crease for the scoop, Mukesh went wide yorker and somehow the batter turned his hands around and across to adjust. Manufactured a new shot like it was magic
Dances down and slaps it over cover. Picked it on the low full toss and carved it. DC's lengths getting predictable
Pulled through midwicket. Short ball around head-height outside off, 105ks. It sits up and Prabhsimran hits it from just in front of him
18-ball fifty for Prabhsimran. Gets there by driving a low full toss through cover. PBKS' best powerplay of all time if I heard Ravi Shastri, on air, right
Good ploy from Prabh, dancing down as Nattu's going yorkers. This came at his shin, he drove it to mid-off's right
Nattu goes for the yorker, gets the length wrong. Low full toss angling away just outside off, Prabh gets on one knee, reaches out and drives over cover
Low full toss at the stumps. Turned into one by the batter dancing down. One hand comes off as Prabh goes for the straight drive, outside edge goes to point
Short ball outside off, tennis-ball bounce takes it over the head
Inswinging yotker on leg stump, squeezed out to point
Full toss goes unpunished. Shin-high at the legs, whipped without much power to midwicket
Priyansh walks down, so Nattu goes for the bouncer outside off. It's too high and is let go
Yorker at pace on leg stump, flicked to midwicket
Low full toss outside off, driven to cover

Arya doesn't care where the fielders are. Pulls the slower back-of-length ball over forward square leg. Right over the fielder. Ball was at the body, he leant forward and didn't extend his arms, still timed it without going at it too early. Tenth six in the fourth over!
Yorker outside off, 130ks. Prabh dances down and inside edges a horizontal-bat cover drive to midwicket
Bouncer at the stumps. Stepped out and left alone by Prabh

How is that still in the ground? Top-tier six, 98 metres! Prabhsimran danced down to the 113ks offcutter, got it on a full length. Didn't get to the pitch but had room to work with and slashed it over long-off
Dances down and scythes a cover drive to the infielder. Bat face opened on impact. Would've been a yorker at the stumps, was picked up on the low full toss
Free hit is tonked too. Change in length but the slow short ball comes at an easy pace at rib-height. Prabhsimran rocks back and pulls it over square leg.
Pitched up and picked up. No ball too! Slot ball down leg, Prabh got to middle stump, well inside the line, and went back in the crease to flick it behind square. Wrists whiplash a bit too
Arya continues on his merry way. Length on leg, got on one knee and swept it behind square for six. Axar gave this air but it didn't turn

Sails downtown. PBKS' fifty up under three overs. Full ball darted at 97ks around off, Arya cleared the front lot and had a swing shaping towards mid-on but with an open face. Ball lost among the crowd for a bit, they didn't want to return it
Full around off, driven to long-off

Ngidi has misjudged this and hit the back of his head onto the ground. The head bounced as he fell and tumbled backwards, fingers crossed it isn't but could be a concussion. His hands went on the head right away. He's rolled to the side and stayed still for a while, been on the ground for more than a minute. A stretcher comes out to take him off. It'll take some time though. The physio has a long chat while holding his neck, Ngidi able to talk which is good news. Was a full ball at the stumps. Arya made room and slashed. Went right up and Ngidi went back from mid-off. The hands were high and spread apart when the ball came down, got no hand on it.  An ambulance now being wheeled in. Doctors, physios, surround Ngidi. A neck brace is slid under his head and goes around his neck as Ponting walks onto the field. A couple of straps across his body as he lies on the stretcher. Visuals cut to the ambulance with closed doors, presumably he's in now.
Axar expects Arya to make room, so he goes well down leg. Batter doesn't move.
Slog sweeps it from well outside off. Was falling a bit as his front leg went well across. The back knee slid laterally to ensure he didn't fall. Fullish ball went over square leg
Length on leg, flicked through square
Mukesh misses his yorker and Priyansh launches a flick over midwicket. Leg-stump line, just below the knee-roll. Needs no footwork to send it 75 metres far
Doesn't carry to deep square leg. On the bounce to Rizvi. Was a full ball on leg that was flicked aerially with a closed bat face
Dances down and slaps it over cover. Length ball around off, Prabh uses the cross-bat, it did turn in the hand a bit. Didn't matter
Wide low full toss is slashed to backward point's right. Half chance at best, Nabi gets one hand on it but the ball rushes past him.
Wide and fullish, Prabh shapes to reach out and lets it go
Marginally too full if at all and Prabh pounces. 131ks just outside off, he got his feet diagonal and swung through mid-on and the ball went in that direction
Overpitched outside off, driven to deep pint
Pulled over midwicket. Back of length outside off, dragged across from waist-height
Pitched right up just outside off, 129ks, Priyansh can't get underneath it. Drives to mid-off's right
Length just outside off, inside edge off a punch aimed at cover, goes to midwicket
Hits the ribs and lands nearby on the leg side. Batters sneak a run. Back of length ball at the stomach, beats the pull
Full inswinger at the stumps, Priyansh doesn't move in the crease and defends to cover
PBKS above the required rate already. Length ball at 128ks around off, doesn't swing, Priyansh swings from low to high and the ball sails high over midwicket. Finishes just beyond the boundary
